summary: Duplicate Advisory: Vikunja: Cross-tenant task-position rows can be injected into arbitrary project views via the unvalidated project_view_id in the task position endpoint (v1 and v2)
details:
### Duplicate Advisory
This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-w39f-h553-h2mx. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

### Original Description
Vikunja before 2.6.0 fails to validate that user-supplied project_view_id in task-position requests belongs to the task's project. Authenticated attackers can insert task position rows into arbitrary other tenant project views via POST or PUT task-position endpoints.
